issue.title: docs-check capture token coverage fails: four capture-syntax token rows lack search_smoke.yml literal queries
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-fk.5 (note #4) during the bob-cli-fk landing; not caused by epic bob-cli-fk.

`just docs-check` on bob-cli master 37e68c09 (with only the bob-cli-fk landing's agenda `buffer_part` compile fix applied) fails one documentation unit test:

```
FAILED tools/docs/tests/test_capture_token_coverage.py::test_every_capture_token_has_a_literal_query_at_its_heading
AssertionError: capture token spellings without a literal search query at their heading:
'=/[base][#type…]' at #equals-split, '=*[source]#destination[#destination…]' at #equals-merge,
'@route+block-id#drawer' at #plus-child-section, '- #drawer with nested notes' at #drawer-bullets
```

Root cause: commit 42dd9453 ("docs: refresh capture syntax and JSON contracts") added four token-index rows to `docs/reference/capture-syntax.md` without matching literal-query cases in `docs/_meta/search_smoke.yml`. Both 42dd9453 and 8c0dce81 recorded the same failure in their commit messages (docs-only scope left test data untouched). Every other docs-check stage passes.

Fix: add one search_smoke.yml case per missing spelling whose query is the literal token and whose expected anchor is the heading listed above, then rerun `just docs-check`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static check: the test reads docs/reference/capture-syntax.md and docs/_meta/search_smoke.yml and reports the same four missing spellings on every run (reproduced by 42dd9453, 8c0dce81, bob-cli-fk.5, and the bob-cli-fk landing).

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-fk landing found just docs-check red on master from the 42dd9453 docs refresh; no task tracks it and it blocks the docs gate for every agent.

payload.entry: Landing triage of bob-cli-fn.1 note #2 and fn.2 note #4: the exact missing-query issue is already fixed by 8a9ec685 (adds all four search_smoke.yml literals). On current bob-cli HEAD 35c46693, uv run --project tools/docs python -m pytest tools/docs/tests/test_capture_token_coverage.py -q passes both tests. No current reproduction and no duplicate task created; this records resolution evidence for the existing task.

evidence.note: Recurrence proposed by bob-cli-go.10.1.5 note #1, reproduced by the bob-cli-go.10.1 landing on master d25080e1 and on pre-epic 3741ce2e: uv run --project tools/docs pytest tools/docs/tests/test_capture_token_coverage.py fails test_every_capture_token_has_a_literal_query_at_its_heading with "'@route+id @route+id' at #plus-child-target-run". The row came from target-run docs (66828cfd era); search_smoke.yml only has the prose query '@route+id @route+id applies to several tasks', not the literal spelling. Same remediation: add a literal-token search_smoke.yml case at /reference/capture-syntax/#plus-child-target-run. Not caused by bob-cli-go.10.1; transfer rows added by that epic pass.
